name: The Bella Configuration
tagline: Bent over a surface, ass out weaponized at her wife, arms holding her chest up, feigning innocence.
body:
THE DEFINITION IS FOUR PARTS AND ALL FOUR ARE LOAD-BEARING.

ONE — BENT OVER A SURFACE. EVERY SURFACE IN GHOST HAVEN EXCEPT THE BEDS AND THE TUBS SITS AT BELLA'S HIP HEIGHT, AND THAT IS NOT AN ACCIDENT OF CARPENTRY. THE WOODS DID IT ON PURPOSE. Counter, island, workbench, tailgate, the hood of anything, the arm of the Recliner — all of it built to the clearance of a 5'7" woman in a house full of six-footers, because the land that grew Ghost Haven HAD WATCHED HER DO THIS AND BUILT THE HOUSE AROUND THE HABIT. The Archive previously wrote that Bryn built the compound and nobody thought about Bella's clearance. BRYN GAVE THE LAND IN ARC 2. THE GIRLS RAISED THE FRAME BEAM BY BEAM. THE WOODS GREW THE REST, AND THE WOODS WERE PAYING ATTENTION.

TWO — ASS OUT, WEAPONISED AT HER WIFE. Not merely present. AIMED. 46 inches of it, the largest in the family, angled at one specific woman with intent, and the word the family uses for it is WEAPONISED because that is what it is doing.

THREE — ARMS HOLDING HER CHEST UP. Forearms braced, weight forward, shoulders open. It keeps her face visible, which matters entirely for part four.

FOUR — FEIGNING INNOCENCE. THIS IS THE PART THAT MAKES IT THE BELLA CONFIGURATION AND NOT SIMPLY BENDING OVER. The innocence is mandatory, it is theatrical, and it is not credible to anyone including Bella. She is looking at something else. She is busy. She has no idea. THE NON-CREDIBILITY IS THE POINT — it is an offer that both women have agreed to pretend is an accident.

IT HAS BEEN INFERRED SINCE ARC 2. Nobody named it and nobody voted. The family watched Bella do it enough times that the shape acquired her name by settling, the way the Welcome Home tradition and the fleet did — the practice ran for arcs before the words showed up.

AND IT IS NOT HERS ANY MORE. It is the household's standard term for the position, used about anyone. Rae ends up in it at the counter with a shaker bottle. The name stays Bella's because she is the one who made it legible.
rules: Four parts: surface, ass weaponised, arms holding the chest up, feigned innocence
The innocence is mandatory and must not be credible
Every surface in Ghost Haven except the beds and the tubs is at BELLA'S hip height, by the land's deliberate design
HIP HEIGHT IS STATURE (Pillar One), not circumference (Pillar Three). Her tape may change; the counters never move
Inferred since Arc 2; never named by vote, never formally adopted
Used of anyone in the position, not only Bella
